question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the highlighted word**

He is **__inclined__ **to stay with the present organisation.
solution:
The correct answer is 'motivated'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Inclined means to be favourably disposed towards or willing to do something. (कुछ करने के लिए अनुकूल या इच्छुक होना)
 
• The** meaning** of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• struggled - make forceful or violent efforts to get free of restraint or constriction. (संघर्ष किया)
 
• mystified - utterly bewilder or perplex (someone). (किसी को पूरी तरह से भ्रमित करना)
 
• motivated - cause (someone) to have interest in or enthusiasm for something. (प्रेरित)
 
• declined - politely refuse (an invitation or offer). (अस्वीकृत)
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that motivated is the correct synonym for the word inclined.
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.
